results.question: Use the Linen Shirt then, all colours.
results.sql: SELECT to_char(o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney', 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sum(ol.quantity) AS units_sold, round(sum(ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount)::numeric, 2) AS line_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND p.title = 'Linen Shirt' AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') >= ('2026-09-30'::date - INTERVAL '2 months' - INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: How have monthly sales of the Linen Shirt (all colours) changed over the last 3 months (July, August, and September 2026, considering today as 2026-09-30)? Revenue is line revenue after discounts, excluding voided orders.
results.answer: Monthly sales for the Linen Shirt across all colours peaked in August 2026 before dipping slightly in September. You sold 25 units for $2,418.79 in July, 33 units for $3,278.35 in August, and 24 units for $2,338.84 in September. These revenue figures are line totals after discounts and exclude voided orders.
